options_schema.description: Owner tuning knobs for the Google Messages connector, resolved from the connector_instance_config_revisions spine. declared_option_kind is this connector's CLAIM only; the platform registry in packages/polyfill-connectors/src/connector-config-option-kind-registry.ts decides what actually gates self-activation, and an option the registry does not classify is enforced as collection_scope.

GMCLI_MAX_CHATS.description: How many conversations to scan per run. Chats are sorted most-recently-active first, so a lower value collects fewer conversations.

GMCLI_MESSAGES_PER_CHAT_LIMIT.description: How many messages to fetch from each conversation per run. A lower value collects less history per chat.

GMCLI_TIMEOUT_MS.description: How long to wait for a single helper-tool invocation before giving up (does not change which chats or messages are collected).

options_schema.description: Operator/owner tuning knobs for the Slack connector, resolved from the connector_instance_config_revisions spine (see reference-implementation/server/stores/connector-instance-config-store.ts). declared_option_kind here is the connector's CLAIM about whether a knob shapes collection scope or only transport -- it is advisory, not authoritative: the platform-owned classification in packages/polyfill-connectors/src/connector-config-option-kind-registry.ts decides what actually gates self-activation, and connector-config-option-kind-honesty.test.ts rejects a manifest that claims 'transport' for a key the platform classifies as 'collection_scope'. A connector cannot widen its own eligibility by mislabeling a knob.

CHANNEL_ALLOWLIST.description: Explicit list of channel IDs to include. Empty list means every accessible channel (subject to MEMBER_ONLY/CHANNEL_TYPES).

CHANNEL_TYPES.description: Channel types to export. Allowed values: public, private, im, mpim.

MEMBER_ONLY.description: When true, export only channels the authenticated user is a member of. When false, includes channels left and channels Slack has archived.

LOOKBACK_DAYS.description: How many days of message history to fetch per channel on a full refresh.

SKIP_FILES.description: When true, skip file attachment metadata (reduces export size; does not change which messages are collected).

RECLAIM_UPLOADS.description: When true, attempt to reclaim previously-failed file uploads on retry (does not change which channels/messages are collected).
